name: Clip-On Open-Ear Earbuds — Pebble
description: Open-ear earbuds that clip onto the ear instead of sitting inside it, in a smooth rounded charging case with a ring light on the front. Bluetooth 6.0 with touch controls, and they work with iPhone and Android.

source.notes: Seller style B78 (skin = Cream, white; B78 black exists but no photo was sent, so not offered). ¥16.90 ≈ ₦3,776.11 per piece (screenshot 4847c2a3); coupon price ¥9.90 not used. Specs from the supplier images: Bluetooth V6.0, non-in-ear, dual mic, touch, Apple/Android/HarmonyOS. USB-C not shown for this style. Supplier photo 7eee9cfe duplicates 66411b91 (not copied). Generic, unbranded. Listing title: Huaqiangbei 10th-generation clip-on open-ear earphones. Lithium battery: sea freight only. China domestic shipping from ¥3 (≈₦670.71) per order, not per item. Left out of the copy on purpose: listing hero shows an AirPods logo (never used), "flagship certified", Hi-Res/IMAX/"Bluetooth 8.0" claims, the rename feature, IPX5 and 1-year warranty (unconfirmed). Same listing also sells style D ("Skin tone: Generation 10", ¥14.90, AirPods Pro-shaped case with EDIFIER/Hi-Res/LDAC marks): not prepared; its originals are in clip-on-earbuds-led/supplier/style-d-not-listed/.
